title: Flat Nine

cards.text: I let them in. There's no flat nine.
My building has only eight flats. Mine is eight, right under the roof.
Every night at 1:10, my intercom crackles and someone whispers, "Nine, please."
I press the button, and footsteps climb past my door, up to the roof.
The roof door has been padlocked for years. Nobody ever comes back down.
Now I hear them pacing on the ceiling above my bed. Dozens of them.
Tonight, the intercom crackled at 1:10. The call came from the roof.

outro: Follow for a new story every night.
